run_ddar_solver_on_geometry_problem: run the DDAR solver on a geometry problem graph with rules and a max level depth
test_orthocenter_proof_failure: test that the DDAR solver correctly fails to prove an orthocenter problem without auxiliary points
test_orthocenter_aux_proof_success: test that the DDAR solver proves an orthocenter problem when an auxiliary point is added
test_incenter_excenter_proof_success: test that the DDAR solver proves the incenter excenter perpendicularity problem
build_geometry_problem_graph: build a geometry problem graph from a problem definition using definitions loaded from defs.txt
